Fig01_SB_Distance_Map: Figure 1. The 101,273-record OpenAlex literature harvest as a 2-D intertopic map. Embed_And_Project gives the SPECTER2 vectors and their UMAP projections; Topic_Model discovers the topics on the 5-D coordinates and names them; distance_map positions one bubble per topic at its mean 2-D coordinate. The pipeline is built from blocks; each one's definition is drawn as a highlighted region beneath it.
Fig02_SB_Favorability_Hist: Figure 2. Signal-versus-noise in the literature harvest. Relevance_Score fuses TF-IDF keyword scoring with SPECTER2 cosine similarity by reciprocal-rank fusion; the histogram is drawn on a log count axis so the thin on-target tail is visible beside the near-zero bulk. The pipeline is built from blocks; each one's definition is drawn as a highlighted region beneath it.
Fig03_OSDR_Journals: Figure 3. Publication venues of the OSDR open-data corpus. The 171 deposited-data PDFs are chunked by chunk_pdfs (Crossref enrichment supplies journal and title), then deduplicate on DOI collapses the 8,646 chunks back to one row per paper before the venue count. No embedding is involved - this figure is about provenance.
Fig04_OSDR_Model_Organisms: Figure 4. Model-organism profile of OSDR. Phrase_Counts sums the corpus-wide unigram counts (the handoff); the synonym sets for each model system - human/clinical, rodent, microbial, Arabidopsis, Drosophila, C. elegans, other - are summed from those counts agent-side into OSDR_Model_Organisms, which the bar chart reads.

Topic_Model: HDBSCAN topic discovery over a coordinate column, with each topic named from its members' distinctive keywords.
Embed_And_Project: SPECTER2 embeddings plus the UMAP projections every later step reads: 5-D for clustering, 2-D for the maps.
Relevance_Score: Hybrid relevance: TF-IDF keyword scoring fused with SPECTER2 cosine similarity by reciprocal-rank fusion.
Taskbook_Portfolio: The NASA Task Book scrape: both collections parsed, stacked with a collection tag, and de-duplicated on task id into 6,353 unique awards.
Four_Corpora: All four windows in one table, tagged by corpus: the OpenAlex harvest, the OSDR and Decadal PDF corpora, and the funded Task Book portfolio. One Combine CSVs node stacks them, so every row keeps its own corpus name.
Theme_Emphasis: The ten spaceflight-risk themes as one long (group, theme, emphasis) table: the Emphasis_Probe unit instantiated once per theme (each with its own probe and score column) and stacked by Combine CSVs, whose source tag -- the theme label each instance wrote -- becomes the theme column.
Theme_Scores: The same ten risk probes scored per passage, projected down to the per-paper profile table the co-occurrence analyses read.
Unknown_Scores: The acknowledged-unknown probe scored three ways -- TF-IDF, SPECTER2 and their reciprocal-rank fusion -- which is what the retrieval diagnostic of Figure 35 grades, and the lexical score the frontier is defined by.
Phrase_Counts: Corpus-wide phrase counts: per-row n-gram frequencies summed into one key/sum table. Set the n-gram to 1 for terms, 2 for bigrams.
Emphasis_Probe: One risk theme's mean-centred emphasis: Semantic Score -> Group Aggregate -> Select Column -> Arithmetic (x1000). The repeated unit behind every cross-corpus and temporal emphasis figure; the query and the theme label are arguments, so one definition serves all ten themes.
